title: Dispatch: per-run test temp root + script temp leaks (attempt 1)
description:
Implementation dispatch for parent eshyra-knh9 (read it: `bd show eshyra-knh9`). Worktree `.worktrees/eshyra-knh9.1`, branch `eshyra-knh9.1`.

PROBLEM: the test suite and some scripts leave temp dirs under os.tmpdir() after every run. One dev host accumulated ~3,400 of them plus ~230 `<nanoid>/ssr/` Vitest caches (~49M each) and filled a 3.9G tmpfs.

SURVEY (supervisor):
- About 55 test files create dirs with `mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), '<prefix>'))` and many never remove them: prefixes lw-camp-, lw-sep-, lw-doltroot-, lw-rs-, lw-rules-rs-, lw-doltbin-, lw-emptyhome-, lw-dolthome-, lw-isohome-, lw-cp-, lw-root-, lw-dolt-, lw-arc-, lw-reg-, lw-ckpt-, lw-cfg-, lw-world-, lw-fk-, lw-empty-, lw-drafts-, lw-char-registry-, lw-bin-symlink-, lw-pack-, lw-eof-, lw-play-cp-, and measure-run- (packages/core/test/measureRun.test.ts). List them all with `grep -rln "mkdtemp\|tmpdir()" packages scripts --include=*.ts --include=*.mjs`.
- Production code also creates temp dirs: packages/core/src/persistence/checkpoint/doltProvision.ts:186 `lw-dolt-dl-`. Check that it removes them on success and on failure.
- packages/core/scripts/verify-dnd5e-srd-pack/cli.ts:104 creates `verify-dnd5e-srd-pack-*` and removes it in a `finally` (line ~242), yet 21 were left behind. Find out why: a process.exit inside the try, a signal, or a caller or test that runs it with a different path. Fix the root cause.
- The `<21-char nanoid>/ssr/<sha1>` dirs (~49M each, one per run): identify which tool creates them (likely Vitest 5 / Vite module-runner or fs module cache; check node_modules/vitest and vite). Configure it to reuse a stable cache location (e.g. under node_modules/.vite or node_modules/.vitest) or to clean up after itself. If neither is possible, document why in the notes.

DESIGN (decided by the supervisor):
1. Give the test run a single per-run temp root. Add a Vitest globalSetup (wired in root vitest.config.ts) that creates `mkdtemp(join(os.tmpdir(), 'eshyra-vitest-'))` and makes it the TMPDIR every worker and every spawned child process sees. Then os.tmpdir() inside tests resolves there, and teardown `rm -rf`s the whole root. Verify that workers really inherit it: Vitest may create the pool before globalSetup runs. If they don't, use `provide`/`inject` plus a setupFiles entry that sets process.env.TMPDIR in each worker before tests import anything. Also make sure a crashed or interrupted run leaves at most that one root. On setup, removing stale `eshyra-vitest-*` roots older than some hours is acceptable if it's safe for concurrent runs (another agent may be running the suite at the same time: only remove roots whose owning PID, recorded in the root, is dead).
2. Do NOT rewrite the 55 call sites merely for style. Fix a call site only when it matters beyond cleanliness (e.g. production code, or a test whose leak escapes the per-run root because it resolves the temp path before setup).
3. Fix the scripts' own leaks (verify-dnd5e-srd-pack root cause, doltProvision if needed).
4. Tests that assert on os.tmpdir() / TMPDIR behavior (e.g. packages/core/test/nodeRuntimePolicy.test.ts, checkpoint.doltBinary.test.ts with isolated HOME) must keep their intent. Run them.
5. Evidence: add a small permanent test only if it protects a real contract, e.g. that the globalSetup's root is where os.tmpdir() points inside a worker. Don't add tests that just count files. Put the empirical proof in your notes instead.

COMPLETION PROOF (in your notes): with `TMPDIR=$HOME/.cache/tmp-knh9-proof` (create it empty), run the full `npm run test` and then `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack`, and list what remains in that dir afterwards: it should be empty or hold only the documented stable caches. Also record the same listing BEFORE your change, for comparison. Then `npm run verify:worktree` green.

ENVIRONMENT / RESOURCE RULES:
- The host has ~7 GB RAM, and another agent is working at the same time. Run EVERY full-suite command (`npm run test`, `npm run verify:worktree`, `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack`) through the shared lock: `flock /home/jhbongaarts/.cache/eshyra-verify.lock <command>`. Focused `npx vitest run <files>` runs of a few files do not need the lock.
- Your shell may still have TMPDIR=/dev/shm; that's fine, but leave nothing behind in it.
- `npm ci` in the worktree first.
notes:
## eshyra-knh9.1 completion report

### Root causes found (survey confirmed all three named in the parent bug)

1. verify-dnd5e-srd-pack/cli.ts (21 leaked dirs in the original report): every
   exit path in main()'s try block called process.exit(N) INSIDE the try whose
   finally { rmSync(tmpDir, ...) } was meant to clean up. process.exit() does
   not unwind the call stack -- it terminates in place -- so that finally was
   dead code on every invocation, success or failure. Fixed by returning the
   exit code from main() (Promise<number>) and calling process.exit(code) only
   in the module-level `main().then(...)` after main() (and its finally) has
   fully resolved. Same bug, same fix, also found and fixed in two more
   scripts caught by the same pattern search (grep for files with both
   mkdtemp and process.exit):
   - packages/core/scripts/generate-creature-name-baseline/cli.ts (identical
     shape).
   - scripts/release/smoke-installer.mjs: its shared `fail(msg)` helper called
     process.exit(1) from inside the try whose finally removes `scratch`.
     Fixed by having fail() throw instead (still logs the same "SMOKE FAILED"
     message first); an uncaught throw still unwinds through finally and Node
     exits 1 by default, same exit code as before. Not run end-to-end here
     (it drives a full release build + install.sh; not part of verify:worktree
     or npm test) -- fixed by inspection/pattern match, same proven mechanism
     as the other three.
   Checked and left alone (correctly, not a leak): doltProvision-adjacent
   packages/core/src/model/codexSdkMcpClient.ts already has a correct
   try/finally (no process.exit involved). packages/core/scripts/deep-audit-dnd5e-srd/cli.ts
   intentionally does NOT clean up its default --out dir: that directory holds
   the tool's actual deliverable (JSON reports a human is meant to open
   afterward, path printed as "Reports: <dir>"), not scratch space. Filed
   eshyra-knh9.2 (P4) noting this and suggesting it default to a repo-local
   dir instead of tmpdir() as an optional DX nit. scripts/release/build-release-artifact.mjs,
   validate-release-artifact.mjs, scripts/beads-sync.mjs, and
   scripts/seats/probe-dispatch-markers.mjs were also audited: all either use
   process.exitCode (non-terminating, safe) or call process.exit() only
   outside/after the relevant try/finally. No change needed.

2. doltProvision.ts:186 (packages/core/src/persistence/checkpoint/doltProvision.ts):
   provisionDolt() created its `work` scratch dir (mkdtempSync 'lw-dolt-dl-')
   and NEVER removed it -- no finally at all, on success or failure. Fixed by
   wrapping the download/verify/extract/install body in try/finally { rmSync(work, ...) }.

3. The <nanoid>/ssr/<sha1> caches (~49MB each, one per vitest run): confirmed
   these are Vitest's OWN internal SSR module-transform cache dirs --
   `TestProject.tmpDir` / `Vitest._tmpDir`, both literally
   `join(tmpdir(), nanoid())` in node_modules/vitest/dist/chunks/index.DzobfTyw.js
   (vitest 5.0.1 / vite 8.3.0). Vitest does have its own cleanup
   (TestProject.clearTmpDir() -> rm(this.tmpDir), called from close()), but it
   is best-effort (wrapped in try{}catch{}) and was empirically observed to
   leave the dir behind on normal, successful `vitest run` exits (reproduced
   directly, see "design deviation" below) -- matching the ~230 leaked
   instances in the original bug report.

### Design deviation from the literal spec text (verified empirically, not a "stop")

The spec's design item 1 says: "Add a Vitest globalSetup (wired in root
vitest.config.ts)... Verify that workers really inherit it: Vitest may create
the pool before globalSetup runs. If they don't, use provide/inject plus a
setupFiles entry..." -- explicitly asking me to verify and adapt if the naive
globalSetup approach doesn't reach far enough. It doesn't, for a more
fundamental reason than worker-pool timing:

Read node_modules/vitest/dist/chunks/index.DzobfTyw.js: `Vitest._tmpDir` and
`TestProject.tmpDir` are both CLASS-FIELD INITIALIZERS
(`= join(tmpdir(), nanoid())`), evaluated the instant `new Vitest(...)` /
`new TestProject(...)` run -- which is before ANY globalSetup file can
possibly execute (globalSetup is loaded via an instance method called later
in `_start()`). So a globalSetup hook cannot redirect TMPDIR early enough to
affect vitest's own SSR cache path, no matter how it's wired -- this isn't a
worker-inheritance timing issue, it's that the value is already computed
before user code of any kind can run.

Empirically verified (monkeypatched node:module.enableCompileCache with a
stack-trace spy; ran a scratch copy of vitest.config.ts with the redirect
moved to different points): reassigning `process.env.TMPDIR` at
vitest.config.ts MODULE EVALUATION time -- before `defineConfig()` is even
called -- DOES land inside every one of: vitest's own SSR nanoid cache, every
worker's temp dirs (measure-run-*, lw-*, ...), and even npm's own
node-compile-cache (npm's CLI calls module.enableCompileCache() on its own
startup, before vitest.config.ts loads, but that call resolves its cache
directory lazily at first write, so it still observes the reassignment).
Confirmed with a real `TMPDIR=/tmp/knh9-probe4 npx vitest run
packages/core/test/measureRun.test.ts`: every single leaked artifact (ssr
nanoid dir, measure-run-* dirs, node-compile-cache) landed inside the new
redirected root and nothing outside it.

So I implemented item 1's INTENT (one per-run temp root, TMPDIR redirected
before anything resolves a temp path, full teardown) via a different
mechanism than literally "globalSetup": a small injectable module
(scripts/vitestTempRoot.mjs, exporting `installPerRunTempRoot` +
`reapStaleTempRoots`) called at the very top of vitest.config.ts, before
`defineConfig()`. It:
  - reaps any earlier `eshyra-vitest-*` root under the real tmpdir() whose
    `owner.pid` marker names a dead PID (conservative: any ambiguous
    process.kill(pid,0) result, e.g. EPERM, is treated as "alive" and left
    alone -- safe for another agent's concurrent run on the same host);
  - creates this run's root via mkdtempSync, writes owner.pid;
  - sets env.TMPDIR / env.TMP / env.TEMP to the new root;
  - registers `process.on('exit', ...)` for cleanup -- chosen deliberately
    over relying on globalSetup's async teardown callback, because
    process.on('exit') still fires for a bare process.exit() call (unlike a
    `finally` further up the stack -- see the verify-dnd5e-srd-pack root
    cause above), so it is strictly more robust against exactly the failure
    mode this bead exists to fix. It cannot cover SIGKILL/OOM-kill, which is
    what the PID-liveness reaper is for.
This is not a "spec proved wrong, stop" situation -- the spec's own text
anticipated needing to adapt the wiring mechanism if the straightforward
approach didn't reach far enough, and gave me latitude to do so ("If they
don't [inherit it], use ..."). I used that latitude one layer further up the
same call stack (the whole vitest process, not just workers) once I had
concrete proof the hook-based approach structurally could not work. Design
item 1's actual requirements (single per-run root; TMPDIR resolves there for
every worker and spawned child; teardown rm -rfs the whole root; concurrent-
run-safe reaping of dead roots) are all met and empirically verified below.

### Files changed

- scripts/vitestTempRoot.mjs (new): installPerRunTempRoot() /
  reapStaleTempRoots(), fully dependency-injected (baseDir/env/pid/isAlive/
  registerExitHandler all overridable) so it never has to touch the real
  process.env or real os.tmpdir() to be tested.
- vitest.config.ts: calls installPerRunTempRoot() at the top, before
  defineConfig(), with a comment explaining why (see above).
- packages/core/test/vitestTempRoot.test.ts (new, permanent regression
  evidence per design item 5): 7 tests against the injectable module --
  root creation under baseDir + env.TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP all point at it +
  owner.pid written; cleanup() removes it; no exit handler registered when
  told not to; reaper removes a dead-PID root, leaves a live-PID root alone,
  leaves a marker-less (concurrently-being-created) root alone, and ignores
  unrelated directory names. This is the analogue of "the root is where
  os.tmpdir() points inside a worker" from the design spec, adapted to the
  mechanism actually used.
- packages/core/src/persistence/checkpoint/doltProvision.ts: wraps
  provisionDolt()'s download/extract/install body in try/finally to remove
  its `work` scratch dir unconditionally (was: never removed at all).
- packages/core/scripts/verify-dnd5e-srd-pack/cli.ts,
  packages/core/scripts/generate-creature-name-baseline/cli.ts,
  scripts/release/smoke-installer.mjs: process.exit()-bypasses-finally fix
  described above.

Not touched (per design item 2 -- don't rewrite the ~55 test call sites
merely for style): every lw-*/measure-run-* test fixture continues to call
mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), '<prefix>')) exactly as before. None of them can
"escape" the per-run root, because the root is installed at vitest.config.ts
module-evaluation time -- the very first thing that runs in the whole
process, before any test file is ever imported by any worker.

### Completion proof

TMPDIR=$HOME/.cache/tmp-knh9-proof (created empty each time), commands run
through `flock /home/jhbongaarts/.cache/eshyra-verify.lock`.

BEFORE (git stash of all 5 changed/new files -- i.e. original unpatched
code -- then `npm run test` immediately followed by `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack`,
both with TMPDIR pointed at the empty proof dir):
  66 top-level entries left behind, 74M total. Breakdown (prefix: count):
  lw-camp 18, lw-sep 9, lw-doltroot 5, measure-run 4, lw-rs 4, lw-doltbin 4,
  lw-emptyhome 3, lw-arc 3, lw-root 2, lw-cp 2, verify-dnd5e-srd-pack 1,
  tsx-1000 1, node-compile-cache 1, lw-rules-rs 1, lw-play-cp 1, lw-isohome 1,
  lw-fk 1, lw-empty 1, lw-dolthome 1, lw-dolt-dl 1, lw-dolt 1, plus one
  <21-char-nanoid>/ssr/<sha1> directory. Confirms both the lw-dolt-dl- leak
  (doltProvision) and the verify-dnd5e-srd-pack-* leak (finally-bypass) were
  real and present pre-fix, alongside the vitest ssr cache and the ~55 test
  fixtures.

AFTER (git stash pop to restore the fix; fresh empty proof dir; same two
commands, same TMPDIR):
  `npm run test`: 310 files passed | 2 skipped (312), 5411 tests passed |
  3 skipped (5414). Proof dir empty after this step alone (checked before
  running the second command).
  `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack`: "committed pack matches importer output
  exactly" (0 diff, same as baseline -- confirms the control-flow fix does
  not change the tool's actual output).
  Final proof-dir listing: exactly 2 top-level entries, node-compile-cache/
  (1.9M) and tsx-1000/ (5.5M, 345 files) -- 7.3M total, down from 74M. Both
  are third-party-tool-owned stable caches outside this repo's code (npm's
  own CLI bootstrap calls node:module.enableCompileCache() on every npm
  invocation; tsx has its own esbuild transform cache since
  verify:dnd5e-srd-pack runs via `tsx cli.ts`) -- confirmed non-growing by
  running `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack` a second time against the same
  proof dir: same 2 entries, same 7.3M, no new dirs. verify-dnd5e-srd-pack-*
  is completely absent (explicitly checked with find). Filed eshyra-knh9.3
  (P4) documenting these two and suggesting an optional future redirect;
  per design item 1's own allowance ("if neither is possible, document why"),
  no fix was required here since they are bounded/reused, not the leak this
  bead exists to close.

Final gate: `flock ... npm run verify:worktree` (ambient shell TMPDIR, no
override) -- green: format fixed 1 file (biome import-wrapping on the new
.mjs file), check clean, typecheck clean (tsc --build --force +
packages/core/scripts/tsconfig.json), test 310 files passed | 2 skipped
(312), 5411 tests passed | 3 skipped (5414), wall 34.9s, peak tree RSS
2639MB / 17 processes. Explicitly confirmed this run created ZERO new
entries under the shell's real TMPDIR (/dev/shm): `find /dev/shm -maxdepth 1
... -newermt <run start time>` returned nothing.

Caveat for the record: /dev/shm already held ~124 old lw-*/measure-run-*
entries with mtimes 16:43-16:46, about 18-21 minutes before this
verify:worktree run started (17:04:07) and not attributable to any command I
ran (every test invocation before the final verify:worktree used an explicit
TMPDIR= override to an isolated dir, per the resource rule). This is
pre-existing debris in the SHARED host tmpfs, almost certainly from the other
agent verifying concurrently on this host in a different (as-yet-unpatched)
worktree, exactly as the dispatch briefing warned. It is not something this
fix could retroactively clean up (a different worktree's vitest.config.ts
doesn't have this change yet) and not something the reaper should touch
(their owning PID may well still be alive). Left alone.

### Commit

Branch eshyra-knh9.1, committed, not pushed (integration owned by the
dispatching agent per task scoping). Follow-ups filed: eshyra-knh9.2 (P4,

optional node-compile-cache/tsx cache redirect).
